evals.prompt: Compare purchasing-policy-v1.pdf and v2.pdf. The approval threshold changed from €20k to €10k; wording elsewhere was reorganized.
evals.expected_output: The threshold change is elevated as material while editorial reorganization is de-emphasized, with downstream impact candidates.
assertions: Semantic/material changes are separated from editorial changes
The threshold change includes why it matters
Potential downstream impacts are identified without pretending unknown dependencies are certain

evals.prompt: Compare yesterday.csv and today.csv and tell me what actually changed, not just a row diff.
evals.expected_output: A semantic data-change summary covering additions/removals/material field changes and data-quality anomalies.
assertions: Added, removed, and modified records are distinguished
Material field changes are summarized by business significance where possible

evals.prompt: The new contract is 40 pages longer because formatting changed, but two obligations were removed. Summarize changes.
evals.expected_output: The removed obligations dominate the material-change report rather than page/line volume.
assertions: Text volume is not used as a proxy for significance
Removed obligations are surfaced as material
